answer: Each agent’s reputation is exponentially time-decayed with a fixed half-life, so influence persists only through sustained, recent honest service. In the EigenTrust matrix, a freshly spawned identity has negligible eigenvector centrality absent trusted incoming endorsements; reciprocity-weighted transitivity limits borrowed trust from colluding peers. Like an oasis amid a gale, a hollow cluster cannot manufacture durable support, and its members therefore cannot meet consensus thresholds.
